description: This file defines an interface 'IHostEnvironmentStatistics' that provides methods to access hosting environment statistics such as total physical memory, CPU usage, and available memory. It is marked as obsolete, indicating it is deprecated in favor of a different provider.

classes.name: IHostEnvironmentStatistics
classes.description: An interface for accessing statistics related to the hosting environment, including memory and CPU usage.

methods.name: TotalPhysicalMemory
methods.description: Gets the total physical memory on the host in bytes.

methods.name: CpuUsage
methods.description: Gets the host CPU usage percentage from 0.0 to 100.0.

methods.name: AvailableMemory
methods.description: Gets the total memory available for allocation on the host in bytes.
